title: Free REST API & MCP Server for Institutional Spot BTC & ETH ETF Daily Net Flows
author: Additional_Yak7970
selftext:
Hi traders & quants!

If you track institutional Spot BTC and ETH ETF net inflows/outflows for your trading algorithms or market sentiment models, I created a free API endpoint & MCP server.

# 📊 Features:

* Consolidated daily net flows for Spot Bitcoin (IBIT, FBTC, GBTC...) and Ethereum ETFs.
* Returns standard JSON output ready for Python / cURL / Node.js.
* Free preview tier & Pro API access.

# 🔗 Quick Resources:

* **Documentation:** [https://yasinozen35.github.io/free-etf-flows-mcp/](https://yasinozen35.github.io/free-etf-flows-mcp/)
